designs.Dstar: dretrain_v2: D-late at 654 hosts (30 x 5) and 400 hosts (10 x 3, 654-anchor settings), D-state at 200 hosts (10 x 3); settings of configs/tuned_d_v2.yaml, epoch limit 400
designs.headline_654_30x5: 654 training hosts, outer resamples r = 0-29 x seeds 0-4, seed-ensemble mean over 5 seeds; S and D from results/analysis/precision_eval_long.parquet (v2); HierDraws.make([164] * 30, 2000, seed 20261008)
designs.sweep_10x3: 200, 400, 654 training hosts, outer resamples r = 0-9 x seeds 0-2, seed-ensemble mean over 3 seeds; S and D from results/analysis/staging_eval_long.parquet (v2); draws of analysis/staging_analysis.make_draws (2000, seed 20261008); D* at 654 hosts is the r = 0-9, seeds 0-2 subset of its 150 runs

facts.initialisation: no init field in hp: default initialisation (the v1 network); configs/tuned_v2.yaml sets arch.init = kaiming and has no D-late entry
facts.network: default-initialisation network (v1), not the final network
facts.settings: configs/tuned_v1.yaml models.D-late at the anchor of each budget (budget_to_anchor)

earlier_dlate.note: context only: default-initialisation network, 10 x 3 design, draws of the sweep; Dlate_minus_D = MAE_D-late - MAE_D-state (positive = D-state more accurate)

payload.estimator: dftgnn.stats.g1 (seed_ensemble, resample_stats, HierDraws, contrast); interval and bounds by analysis/c1/final_network.a_entry; inside_pm_0p01 = two-sided 95% interval strictly inside (-0.01, +0.01) eV; n_resamples_above_delta counts per-resample gaps strictly above delta
payload.label: re-tuned descriptor network D*, dretrain_v2, spec sha256 c33cfa33aac3ed56c46c9802abbf70f63e7b030386043f233e5761c9b9b60f65; compared with the structure-only network S and the previous descriptor network D of the final (He-initialised) network

paper_reference.note: D* exists only at 200, 400 and 654 hosts, so its N* is over those three

headline.final_network_B654_30x5.reference: results/derived_c1/final_network_summary.json payload.table.rows.B654_30x5 (MAE_S, MAE_D with ci95; A with ci95, one-sided bound)

headline.precision_v2_30x5_654.reference: results/precision_a_b400_b654.json payload.v2.30x5.654 (site, within-host and host-mean metrics of S, D and S - D)

staging.staging_fair.reference: results/derived_staging/staging_fair.json payload.budgets.200/400/654 (MAE of S, D, P, P_old; S - D, P - S, P - D with every bound)

sweep.dclass_gaps.reference: results/derived_dclass/dclass_gaps.json payload.budgets.*.MAE and .gaps (S, D, D-host, D-site)

sweep.final_network_B200_B400_B654.reference: results/derived_c1/final_network_summary.json payload.table.rows.B200/B400/B654 (S, D MAE with ci95; A with ci95 and one-sided bound)

sweep.precision_v2_10x3.reference: results/precision_a_b400_b654.json payload.v2.10x3.400/654 (site, within-host and host-mean metrics of S, D and S - D)

sign_convention.Dlate_minus_Dstate_v1: MAE_D-late - MAE_D-state, default-initialisation network (positive = D-state more accurate)
sign_convention.Dstar_minus_class: MAE_D* - MAE_class (positive = the single descriptor class more accurate)
sign_convention.S_minus_class: MAE_S - MAE_class (positive = the class more accurate than structure alone)

P_minus_S.report: P worse; different but within the equivalence margin

staging.note: P is the retrained P1 (stage p1v2b) composed with the previous D checkpoints (stage pcompv2b); P - D* therefore compares the staged network built on the previous energy head with the re-tuned network D*, two different networks, not the staging cost of D*
